text: Program Description I. Course Overview 1. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. BIFT divides students into three levels based on their Chinese proficiency: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced, with each level of different classes. 2. Objectives: Beginner Class focuses on basic Chinese knowledge training. Intermediate Class improves reading skills and develops writing skills while consolidating basic Chinese knowledge. Advanced Class guides students to understand Chinese culture more comprehensively and accurately and integrate into Chinese society while further consolidating and improving listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. 3. Duration: One semester/One year 4. Curriculum: A combination of listening and speaking courses and comprehensive courses will be used to teach the Chinese language systematically. At the same time, Chinese culture study tours or extracurricular language practice activities will be arranged on irregular basis. II. Class Duration According to students' number, each semester has 16 to 20 weeks and each week has 12 to 20 class hours. Customized courses regarding study tour and exchange projects are set up according to actual needs.
